annotations.title: Read what happened across the roster

description: What happened across the roster since a date — the coach's bell: each session an athlete completed (with the recording's summary), what they wrote about it, thresholds the evidence has outgrown, drafts waiting for a decision. Grouped by athlete, newest first, with the tool that has the detail. Default: the last seven days. Each update has an id and says whether it is `unread` in the app's bell; mark_updates_read clears them there too. Draws a page in the chat — "What happened" — so the figures are on screen: refer to what the page shows rather than retyping it, and spend your words on what it means.

athlete_id.description: One athlete only. Omit for the whole roster.
